chat.text: With static routes pointing to the next node you make this actually nicely scalable solution

chat.text: @Vishnu - It sure reduces complexity as packet actually get's routed based on static routes at each tier. In your uA chain scenario even static routes would not be needed but paths would need to be carefully programmed by controller.

chat.text: Thanks, Mark, Jasmeet, and Abhishek, for sharing your experiences with real-world data center deployments. You struck exactly the right level of technical detail, and it's really appreciated it.

chat.text: +1 thanks to Mark, Jasmeet, and Abhishek! it's interesting to see how different IP networks can be, compared to a classical ISP backbone. And we all go SRv6 :smiley:
